messages.content: Hi, We are only in charge of crossed meters and crossed address between SPOW and other suppliers so we are unable to take any actions. Therefore, we cannot action this request. Apologies for the inconveniences.

MPAN: 2600002773160 is currently incorrectly linked with GUID:00-23-7E-FE-60-21-38-D7, because of this the ESME ID in ECOES is not updating as it should. Could you please remove the incorrect MPAN from this GUID? Once this is confirmed we will then send a D0367 for the correct MPAN.
